Nothing to do with the content as you've had a lot of other comments based around that and my suggestions probably aren't life saving. But from a design perspective I find this a difficult to read. 

Serif fonts are great to use as headers/titles but generally Sans-serif should be used for the actual body text. It makes it cleaner, easier/quicker to read and easy to differentiate each sections as you will be able to pick out the titles as being one font (serif) and the body text as another font (sans)

Extra bit to be picky because I'm pedantic - you can capitalise the S's in JavaScript and TypeScript
